title: Earlier choices of agents the founder reviewed and left as they are
decision: On 2026-10-08 the founder was shown these choices one at a time and kept each: disputed entries stay in the balance and receive payments, and are left out only of reminders (DEC-026); one entry is at most 100 000 000 UZS (DEC-027, DEC-036); customers are sent nothing when a shop is deleted (DEC-038); owners and managers may export (DEC-055); receipts are kept three years until legal advice says otherwise (DEC-056); a former owner becomes a suspended manager when ownership is reassigned (DEC-062, apart from its shop limit, see DEC-065); the Mini App keeps its session token until the window closes (DEC-063); and the architecture document is to be amended to name nginx (DEC-058). The other choices in DEC-021 to DEC-063 were not shown to him and stay pending
context: Answered by the founder on 2026-10-08 when asked by the agent in the working session
rationale: Each was put to him with alternatives and he chose the current behaviour
